rows.en: ...Dr. Gura, how are preparations for the operation to conquer the surface progressing?
rows.notes: Scene switches to Burai questioning Dr. Gura about invasion preparations.

rows.en: We're producing Hyakki mechs and Hyakki soldiers at a rapid pace, but...
rows.notes: Dr. Gura reports accelerated production to Burai; retained trailing but, continuing into 65. Central descriptive class terms confirmed: Hyakki mechs and Hyakki soldiers.

rows.en: I believe it will take a little more time to reach the planned numbers.
rows.notes: Completes 64 production report; planned quantity is the target, not an immediate deadline.

rows.en: Then, Hidler, report on the current situation on the surface.
rows.notes: Burai turns to Hidler and orders a surface status report.

rows.en: There is a lull at present... Skirmishes between the Federation forces and Giganos continue...
rows.notes: Hidler reports lull and continuing skirmishes; retained source trailing continuation into 68.

rows.en: Neither Mu nor Tekkoryu has made any notable moves.
rows.notes: Completes force-status report. Central source review confirms glossary parenthetical Iron Dragon is explanatory, not spoken; source-only Tekkoryu retained. Meaning correction, not fit compression.

rows.en: Then what is the situation in space?
rows.notes: Burai asks Hidler for space status; restored situation predicate.

rows.en: Those calling themselves the Martian Successors have risen in rebellion, but have made no concrete move since.
rows.notes: Hidler reports the rebellion and absence of a concrete subsequent move; not absence of rebellion.

rows.en: Those alien scum are in the same position.
rows.notes: Hidler adds aliens also have not acted; contempt retained in scum.

rows.en: I see...
rows.notes: Burai acknowledges report.

rows.en: Emperor Burai, I believe now is the perfect opportunity for our Hyakki Empire to conquer the surface.
rows.notes: Hidler recommends immediate conquest to Emperor Burai; our Hyakki Empire restored.

rows.en: Do not be hasty, Hidler. In this war... whoever judges the times will win in the end. Thus, we must first build up our strength now.
rows.notes: Burai rejects haste, explains judging the times and prioritizes strength; no claim that invasion is abandoned. Measured four-line initial overflow compressed by tightening triumph/priority phrasing, preserving all propositions.

rows.en: Yes, sir.
rows.notes: Hidler formally acknowledges order. Conventional acknowledgment kept as an intentional short response.

rows.en: And to make my Hyakki Fortress Island even more formidable...
rows.notes: Retained deliberate trailing conditional goal into 77; my Fortress Island preserves possessive.

rows.en: We need the Getter Ray amplifier, the Photon Power reactor, and Zeorymer.
rows.notes: Completes 76: required targets are all three technologies/unit, not alternatives. Central descriptive term Photon Power reactor confirmed.

rows.en: Yes, sir! Next time, I will surely...!
rows.notes: Retained source promise trailing off; supplied I will for Hidler's commitment to acquire targets.

rows.en: Then sortie. While those on the surface glare at one another, you will obtain what I desire.
rows.notes: Burai orders Hidler to sortie and seize desired targets during other factions' standoff.

rows.en: Hyakki, Buraaaaai!
rows.notes: Preserved sourced salute Hyakki, Buraaaai with source shout elongation; not an attack name.

rows.en: ...Miku, how is Masato doing?
He's shut himself away in Zeorymer's cockpit... He won't even answer when I call to him.
...Can you think of anything that happened in the last battle?
Just like when we fought Lanstar of the Winds... Masato seemed to become a different person halfway through...
So he destroyed those two Hakke robots without any regard for #部隊名.
Yes...
Was the treatment I gave him before putting him in Zeorymer too effective?
rows.notes: Oki privately wonders whether the treatment he administered had excessive effect; source does not specify its nature.

rows.en: Or could it be... No, that is impossible. That man was definitely...
rows.notes: Retains deliberate unfinished recognition of that man; no invented dead/alive predicate.

rows.en: Oki... What on earth is happening to Masato...?
I don't know. But as things stand, it has become difficult to assign you two to #部隊名.
Huh...? You were going to assign us to that unit?
That's right. Hau Dragon isn't the only organization after Zeorymer.
Its Dimensional Coupler System could become a target for other enemy organizations.
That's true...
#部隊名 has GEAR's Dendoh and the D-Weapons, for starters...
rows.notes: List continues in row 15; retains source trailing list.

rows.en: Evangelions, RahXephon and other top-secret machines from various organizations are all gathered there. Do you know why?
rows.notes: Continues row 14 list; all organizations contribute top-secret machines.

rows.en: To give the enemy a single target...
rows.notes: Purpose-clause answer to why in row 15; deliberate answer fragment retained.

rows.en: And to use the forces gathered in that unit to protect those secrets from the enemy...
rows.notes: Second purpose-clause answer; deliberate continuation retained.

rows.en: Exactly. As they say, the best place to hide a tree is in a forest...
Even though they know some of their secrets will leak to one another...?
rows.notes: Leaks are among allied organizations; not leaks to enemies.

rows.en: If we had only one or two enemy organizations, this would be unthinkable, but...
rows.notes: Counterfactual rationale trails into row 21.

rows.en: With allies and enemies this tangled together, we have no choice.
Of course, some of them, like TERRA and NERV, are still probing each other's motives.

rows.notes: Intentional silence.

rows.en: Besides, Hau Dragon is after you and Masato yourselves, too.
rows.notes: Targets are Miku and Masato personally in addition to Zeorymer.

rows.en: You could also say that joining the mobile #部隊名 would be safer than staying here at Last Guardian.
...Will #部隊名 accept us and Zeorymer?
I've already laid the groundwork with GEAR's Chief Shibuya and the Earth Federation Army's top brass.
Zeorymer, which we've kept hidden for over a decade...
rows.notes: Source dangling object clause continues into row 28; retained fragment, no invented action.

rows.en: We cannot let Hau Dragon or any other enemy organization take it from us now.
...Of course, Oki. After all, that is your job.
rows.notes: Masato enters with cold contempt toward Oki; no softened deference.
Both uses are shock: arrival at i043b:49 and order defiance at i043b:63.

rows.en: Masato...!
...Masato, what was that way of fighting near the Science Fortress Laboratory?
rows.notes: Oki reprimands reckless fighting; location uses glossary spelling.
Silence checked at all five original uses.

rows.en: That's right... You fought in a way that put #部隊名 in danger...
rows.notes: Miku reproaches the danger to allied unit, not merely their participation.

rows.en: ...Heh, heh heh... They are nothing but pawns. Yes, pawns to deal with the small fry.
rows.notes: They refers to squad members; small fry are lesser enemies. Preserves contempt.

rows.en: H-how can you say that...!
rows.notes: Miku protests Masato's insulting language; source trailing protest retained. Meaning correction: replaces added entitlement claim with shocked protest at his language; restored subject and verb, stutter and trailing ending preserved.

rows.en: Hmph. Does someone as worthless as you dare to question me?
rows.notes: Masato belittles Miku explicitly.

rows.en: Have you forgotten your place? Or is this an act to soften me up?
rows.notes: Masato accuses Miku of acting to manipulate/pacify him; control referent settled by row 43. Meaning refinement: idiomatic soften me up conveys conciliation/manipulation without asserting complete control; the accusation is aimed at Miku.

rows.en: A-an act...! I'm just worried about you, Masato...
rows.notes: Miku protests accusation and expresses concern directly to Masato.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... You have been well trained.
rows.notes: Masato says Miku has been trained/coached, leaving trainer unspecified.

rows.en: Masato... Are you...?
rows.notes: Oki trails off in suspicion about identity, corroborated by fresh row 50; no identity supplied.

rows.en: Heh heh heh heh... Let me tell you something, Oki. Do not give me orders.
Don't even think of controlling me. I'll do whatever I please...
rows.notes: Masato addresses Oki after forbidding orders; restores I and the refusal of control.

rows.en: What did you say...!?
rows.notes: Oki reacts to Masato refusing control.

rows.en: ! Are we under attack!?
rows.notes: Oki reacts to an attack alert. Standalone ! retains the abrupt startle before his question.

rows.en: Th-this energy reading...!?
rows.notes: Miku recognizes the energy signature; preserves the stammer and deliberately unfinished astonishment.

rows.en: Those Hakkeshu bastards never learn...!
rows.notes: Cruel Masato contemptuously calls out the Hakkeshu returning despite earlier losses; bastards carries the contempt of the collective suffix.

rows.en: Masato...!
rows.notes: Oki urgently calls Masato by name; intentional vocative fragment.

rows.en: I'm heading out in Zeorymer...!
rows.notes: Masato states his own deployment in Zeorymer; I restored.

rows.en: Those eyes... That way of speaking...! No... No, it can't be...!
rows.notes: Thought: Oki recognizes the eyes and speech but does not name the suspected identity. Source nominative reaction fragments and repeated disbelief retained.

rows.en: Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: ガデス様 rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: お嬢様 = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; ロム様 -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: くれる object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: 伝えてくれ has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: 後を頼む: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: やられた has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary ＥＶＡ量産機 = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; ガルファ speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term ガルファ, do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit (ガルファ素体 = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: お館様 kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: 脱出しないと has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: 脱出しなきゃ has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: 脱出 has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: ここまでかよ / 情けねえ: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: 一巻の終わり ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: 覚えていろ rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: 頼んだぜ: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: 大佐 = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: ここまで: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: なんという… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. Shoot down Zeorymer of the Heavens
rows.notes: Plain objective, one segment, no @.

rows.en: There you are...!
rows.notes: Ritsu addresses the newly arriving Zeorymer.

rows.en: ...So it's the Moon this time. Miku, you're ready, aren't you?
rows.notes: Masato identifies the opposing Moon and checks Miku readiness; quoted Moon is the unit element.

rows.en: ...Well, it doesn't matter. As long as the system works properly, there's no problem.
rows.notes: After the silent intervening Masato use s0430:210, he dismisses the concern and requires the system to function; no invented reply from Miku.

rows.en: I've been waiting... I've been waiting for this moment alone.
rows.notes: Ritsu repeats his long wait, emphasizing this moment alone; continues into55.

rows.en: Only to destroy you, Zeorymer of the Heavens...
rows.notes: Intentional grammatical continuation of54: only to destroy Zeorymer. Full source unit name retained. Final restores the matching fragment instead of repeating the verb from54.

rows.en: Hmph... The night has no need for two moons. Especially before these 'Heavens'.
rows.notes: Masato mocks the Moon using the two-moons/night image, then invokes his own Heavens. Source elliptical second sentence retained as a deliberate rhetorical fragment.

rows.en: In place of the Wind, the Fire and the Water... Rose C'est La Vie of the Moon will tear the Heavens apart!
rows.notes: Ritsu avenges Wind, Fire and Water; named unit and Heavens elemental wordplay retained.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... The weaker the dog, the louder it barks. Now, let me hear it... The howling of a beaten dog...!
rows.notes: Masato uses both weaker-dog barking and beaten-dog howling insults; request direction is Masato demanding to hear Ritsu howl.

rows.en: Here I come, Zeorymer!
rows.notes: Ritsu announces an attack on Zeorymer; I restored.

rows.en: G-ghhh! Pull back! Retreat!!
rows.notes: Separate event5: Hidler orders his forces to withdraw, with strained exclamation retained.

rows.en: Now, show me what the Moon can do!
rows.notes: Event8: cruel Masato challenges Ritsu to display the Moon power.

rows.en: This man is Zeorymer's pilot...!?
rows.notes: Ritsu reacts to the man piloting Zeorymer; man is explicit in source, no identity revelation added.

rows.en: I've got you now, Zeorymer!
rows.notes: Ritsu claims he has caught Zeorymer in his attack.

rows.en: What... What happened...? I... Why am I...!
rows.notes: Masato switches to the confused first-person voice. Both interrupted questions remain incomplete at the source stopping points.

rows.en: Masato! Focus on the enemy in front of you right now!
rows.notes: Miku tells Masato to concentrate on the current enemy, not on his confusion.

rows.en: Stay out of my fight with Zeorymer!!
rows.notes: Ritsu orders allied interveners out of his personal fight against Zeorymer.

rows.en: Tch...! It's not like we WANT to cover him, either!
rows.notes: Tetsuya reluctantly provides cover for Masato. WANT preserves the resentful emphasis; him follows sourced male Masato profile.

rows.en: If you mean to attack me, then my Rose C'est La Vie of the Moon will take you on!
rows.notes: Ritsu answers the allies intervention: if they initiate an attack, his Moon unit will fight them. Speaker agency and condition preserved.

rows.en: Ugh... Why do we have to help a jerk like that...!?
rows.notes: Asuka resents having to help Masato; jerk maintains contempt.

rows.en: The pilot of that robot... Of Zeorymer... Could he be scared...?
rows.notes: Shinji observes the Zeorymer pilot and tentatively wonders whether he is frightened. He refers to sourced male Masato, not gender inferred from a name; robot identification fragments retained.

rows.en: You dare get distracted in the middle of a fight...! You'll pay for underestimating this Moon!!
rows.notes: Ritsu rebukes distraction during combat and threatens payment for underestimating the Moon; Moon remains element/title.

rows.en: Hyakki Empire! What are you doing here!?
rows.notes: Ryoma asks the Hyakki Empire purpose in appearing; question direction preserved.

rows.en: Isn't it obvious!? Our aim is to obtain a powerful source of energy...
rows.notes: Hidler states the immediate energy acquisition objective; trailing ellipsis leads to74.

rows.en: Then we will use it to conquer the world! That is the true goal of our Hyakki Empire!
rows.notes: Hidler gives the ultimate world-conquest objective and explicitly names the Hyakki Empire.

rows.en: Hmph... You just keep blabbering about your selfish plans...!
rows.notes: Hayato condemns the self-serving plans Hidler has just explained; final corrects generic whatever-you-please wording to selfish plans.

rows.en: As long as we're here, you won't get your hands on Getter Rays or any other energy!
rows.notes: Benkei denies both Getter Rays and every other energy while the allies stand against the enemy.

rows.en: So today you're looting in the chaos! I thought demons used brute force, but you're surprisingly petty!
rows.notes: Koji calls opportunistic theft in the ongoing battle looting in the chaos. The fire-thief idiom is not a literal burning-location event. Demons preserves the Hyakki name pun; petty contrasts their assumed brute force.

rows.en: Silence! Silence! Winning the greatest victories with the fewest moves is how I, General Hidler, will make my name!
rows.notes: Hidler insists maximum results with minimum moves enhance his reputation. Source rank-bearing name uses fixed General Hidler, speaker remains Hidler.

rows.en: So you're the Hyakki Empire! We've just met, but I'd like you to leave the stage at once!
rows.notes: Tetsuya first meets the Hyakki Empire and mock-politely demands their immediate exit; stage metaphor preserves the source performance register.

rows.en: I think not! You're the ones I'll crush!
rows.notes: Hidler refuses dismissal and threatens to crush the allied forces instead.

rows.en: Hyakki Empire! No matter how often you attack, as long as we're here...
rows.notes: Duke begins his recurring defiant declaration; source as-long-as clause remains deliberately unfinished before Hidler interrupts.

rows.en: I've heard enough of that speech! Today I'll make sure you can never open that impudent mouth again!
rows.notes: Hidler interrupts the familiar declaration, threatening to silence Duke permanently; full threat retained.

rows.en: Here I come, Hyakki Empire! Now that I've returned to Earth, I won't let you do as you please!!
rows.notes: Kazuya announces his return to Earth and refuses to let the Hyakki Empire have their way.

rows.en: So you're Daimos! Don't think we're the same as those worthless Baam!
rows.notes: Hidler addresses Daimos and disparages the Baam as inferior; glossary Baam is the alien-race term.

rows.en: Zeorymer! We of the Hyakki Empire will be taking your limitless energy!
rows.notes: Hidler explicitly names Zeorymer limitless energy as the Hyakki Empire prize.

rows.en: Ghh... Ugh...!
rows.notes: Masato groans under attack; no invented action or words. Next source use245 has Miku urging him to fight.

rows.en: Fight, Masato! You mustn't let them have Zeorymer!

rows.notes: Masato remains wordlessly stunned immediately before the awakening of his aggressive side.
Retained source bewildered incomplete self-reference.

rows.en: Masato...! Is that you, Masato!?
Wh-where am I...? I'm in Zeorymer...!? Why am I here!?
Hau Dragon's Hakke robot attacked us... so you went out...!
rows.notes: Miku tells Masato why he deployed; launched subject/action restored despite trailing source delivery.

rows.en: I did!? In Zeorymer!?
rows.notes: Answers Miku: Masato asks whether he himself deployed in Zeorymer.

rows.en: ...That's right...
Th-that's... impossible...!
Hm? It's slowed down...!?
rows.notes: Ritsu observes Zeorymer slowing; machine referred to as it.

rows.en: I... got into Zeorymer of my own free will...?
rows.notes: Voluntary boarding inferred from Masato questioning the deployment.

rows.en: ...B-but... I remember. I'm sure I told Oki... that I'd go out in Zeorymer...
rows.notes: Masato recalls telling Oki that he would deploy; no invented memory loss diagnosis.

rows.en: Masato...
B-but that wasn't my choice...! That wasn't what I really wanted...!
rows.notes: Preserves both lack of volition and lack of genuine wish.

rows.en: Wh-what am I...!?
rows.notes: Self-directed identity question inferred from lack of genuine will and the following question about what he was before; source trailing delivery retained.

rows.en: ...Is this really Zeorymer of the Heavens, which defeated Wind, Fire and Water...?
rows.notes: Elemental short names remain Wind, Fire and Water; full Zeorymer title retained.

rows.en: Is this the Zeorymer created by that man I hate with every fiber of my being...!?
rows.notes: Source explicitly identifies a man; identity withheld.

rows.en: Tell me, Miku! What's happened to me!? What was I back then!?
rows.notes: What was I preserves identity crisis, not merely a question about behavior.

rows.en: ...Masato...!

rows.notes: Retained source panicked incomplete self-reference.

rows.en: ...Masato, fight for now! The enemy is right in front of us!
U-ugh...!
This is no good. He's confused...!
rows.notes: He is Masato; gender sourced in character profile.

rows.en: Oki, we can't fight the enemy properly in this condition!
Please ask #部隊名 to come to our rescue!
rows.notes: Miku asks Oki to request rescue from the squad; exact placeholder preserved.

rows.en: I've already contacted them. Hold out until they arrive, whatever it takes.
And... other enemies may pick up Zeorymer's energy signature and appear. Be very careful.
rows.notes: Other enemies may detect energy signature; warning is prospective despite Hidler event.

rows.en: Y-yes...!
I don't know what happened, but if you can't unleash your power, all the better...!
Vanish before my moonlight, Zeorymer!
rows.notes: Literal moonlight; exact named-attack glossary entry unavailable. Coordinator sourced literal moonlight centrally; no weapon substitution or English-body change.
uncertain: Literal lowercase moonlight retains the elemental taunt. No exact Akurasu attack entry; the secondary weapon list does not establish this phrase as a named attack. Independent licensed wording unestablished.

rows.en: Masato, the enemy's coming! For now, just fight back!
Ugh... ngh...! Damn it!
! What is this signal!?
rows.notes: Ritsu notices arriving reinforcements, without naming them before Miku.

rows.en: Masato, help has arrived!
Help...!? Could it be... the people from the other day...?
rows.notes: Rescuers inferred as people from previous encounter; ellipsis retains hesitation.

rows.en: Zeorymer... is it...!
That's the robot that attacked the other day, ignoring us... isn't it!?
rows.notes: Maria recalls Zeorymer attacking while disregarding the allied group.

rows.en: Why do we have to help that thing!?
rows.notes: Thing refers to the robot, avoiding guessed pilot gender.

rows.en: Exactly! Who does it think it is!?
rows.notes: Asuka agrees with Maria about Zeorymer; impersonal machine reference retained.

rows.en: I can't blame Maria and Asuka for feeling that way.
Even though GEAR and Last Guardian do have ties...
rows.notes: Retained deliberate trailing concession across Vega thoughts.

rows.en: Honestly, I have my own doubts about what Zeorymer did last time...
rows.notes: Vega privately shares doubts despite institutional ties.

rows.en: Either way, unless we stop those enemies, the damage to the city will only keep spreading.
rows.notes: Duke argues prevention of spreading urban damage justifies intervention.

rows.en: We have good reason to support Zeorymer here.
rows.notes: Duke justifies helping Zeorymer after warning of spreading urban damage; support direction preserved.

rows.en: If it really is on our side.
rows.notes: Tetsuya questions the robot's allegiance, not Duke's.

rows.en: Tetsuya...!
rows.notes: Reproachful interrupted name call retained.

rows.en: I'm damn well not letting the higher-ups jerk me around with their schemes, Duke Fleed.
rows.notes: Higher-ups' schemes and unwillingness to be manipulated retained; full Duke Fleed address.

rows.en: I agree. We still have no guarantee it's on our side.
rows.notes: Hayato backs Tetsuya's distrust; full subject restored.

rows.en: Wait! This is no time for us to argue!
rows.notes: Ryoma interrupts allies' argument, not the enemies.

rows.en: ...Tetsuya, Hayato. If Zeorymer becomes our enemy...
rows.notes: Conditional trails into row137; deliberate unfinished clause retained.
uncertain: Deliberate unfinished conditional continues into row137.

rows.en: I'll steel myself to face it too. Does that answer satisfy you?
rows.notes: Resolve to face an enemy Zeorymer is inferred from row136, without specifying destruction; full subject/action.
uncertain: Context supplies confrontation with an enemy Zeorymer; exact action intended by resolve is unstated, so destruction is not added.

rows.en: ...Yeah.
rows.notes: Reluctant assent to Duke's promise.

rows.en: That's fine by me.
rows.notes: Acceptance of Duke's answer; subject/action restored.

rows.en: ...Captain, I believe we should remain wary of Zeorymer for now. Wouldn't you agree?
rows.notes: Quattro gives Bright a cautious assessment and seeks agreement.

rows.en: Yes. All units, provide support from medium range.
rows.notes: Bright orders allied units to support Zeorymer at medium range.

rows.en: Roger. All right, let's sortie!
rows.notes: Amuro acknowledges and leads deployment.

rows.en: So they're #部隊名...! But I won't let them get in my way!
rows.notes: Ritsu identifies arriving allies; exact squad placeholder retained.

rows.en: 1. Zeorymer of the Heavens is shot down@2. An allied mothership is shot down
rows.notes: Defeat conditions, not objectives to perform; two plain segments preserved.

rows.en: Damn it...! I can't defeat the Heavens like this!
rows.notes: Heavens preserves explicit source-short designation for Zeorymer of the Heavens; frustrated impossibility retained.
uncertain: Source-short Heavens follows Zeorymer of the Heavens; no independent standalone English alias is established.

rows.en: I won't forget this humiliation!
rows.notes: Threat to remember humiliation, without adding revenge action.

rows.en: Th... They retreated...?
rows.notes: Masato reacts to Ritsu's withdrawal; source stutter retained as interrupted first syllable.

rows.en: At least we managed to pull through for now...
rows.notes: Temporary survival relief; plural we restored from joint situation.

rows.en: ! W-what are these readings!?
rows.notes: Sensor reaction, clarified by next row's Hyakki identification; startled punctuation and stutter retained.

rows.en: ! Is that the Hyakki Empire!?
rows.notes: Ryoma recognizes newly arriving Hyakki forces; full interrogative restored.

rows.en: Those bastards showed up again! They never learn!
rows.notes: Koji's derision and recurrent incorrigible intrusion retained.

rows.en: What are they after this time!?
rows.notes: Boss asks the new arrivals' aim.

rows.en: I followed the energy readings of that robot called Zeorymer... and even the Getter Robo lot are here.
rows.notes: Hidler tracked Zeorymer's energy and unexpectedly found Getter Robo too; contemptuous lot retained.

rows.en: Then I'll defeat them and make Zeorymer ours!
rows.notes: Hidler intends both to defeat the allies and seize Zeorymer.

rows.en: First the Getter Ray amplifier, and now they're after Zeorymer. They're like petty thieves.
rows.notes: Hayato links current theft attempt to earlier Getter Ray amplifier targeting; petty-thief insult retained.

rows.en: I won't give the Hyakki Empire any more power! Let's go, Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Ryoma refuses added power to Hyakki Empire and calls Hayato and Benkei into action.

rows.en: You bet!
Captain, all enemy unit readings have vanished!
rows.notes: Hari speaker prefill preserved; report addressed to Ruri.

rows.en: ...That leaves Zeorymer.
rows.notes: Ruri turns attention to remaining Zeorymer after enemies vanish.

rows.en: It never acted the way it did last time, but... What do we do, Bright?
rows.notes: Amuro notes lack of previous dangerous conduct; robot referent retained as it.

rows.en: ...We'll have to get them to explain the situation.
rows.notes: Bright demands explanation from Last Guardian; row161 states the condition.

rows.en: If they need our cooperation as they did this time, that is.
rows.notes: Conditional continuation of row160 retained, with they referring to Last Guardian.
uncertain: Dependent conditional continues row160 at the source row boundary.

rows.en: Captain, Last Guardian is contacting our ship.
rows.notes: Saegusa reports inbound communication from Last Guardian to the ship.

rows.en: Oh... They've contacted us first, have they?
rows.notes: Quattro observes Last Guardian taking initiative.

rows.en: It seems the circumstances are different from last time.
rows.notes: Misato compares present circumstances with prior encounter.

rows.en: Yes. ...Saegusa, connect the communications line.
rows.notes: Bright agrees and orders Saegusa to connect the call.

rows.en: Roger!
You're assigning Zeorymer to #部隊名...?
rows.notes: Bright questions proposed posting of Zeorymer to the squad; exact placeholder retained.

rows.en: Yes.
rows.notes: Oki confirms the assignment.

rows.en: Wasn't it Last Guardian's most closely guarded secret?
rows.notes: Bright recalls Zeorymer's secrecy within Last Guardian.

rows.en: ...Indeed. That's why I believe you can understand our reason, Colonel.
rows.notes: Oki implies the reason rather than revealing secrets; explicit Colonel address retained.

uncertain: Rendered the source's long silence as '...'.

rows.en: So they want us to act as bait. To draw Hau Dragon's attention...
rows.notes: Thought retained; Misato deduces their squad is bait, with deliberately trailing explanatory fragment.
uncertain: Deliberate trailing purpose fragment retained after a complete statement.

rows.en: I guess things are the same everywhere.
rows.notes: Thought retained; Haruka recognizes similar organizational circumstances without inventing a specific institution.
uncertain: Same everywhere alludes to other organizations' secret-machine circumstances; no specific organization is named.

rows.en: ...I expect the official orders will reach you in due course.
rows.notes: Oki expects official orders to be sent to Bright's side later; expectation is not a guarantee.

rows.en: You're telling us to handle Zeorymer? After what it did last time...
rows.notes: Bright objects to handling the robot after prior misconduct; unfinished after-clause retained.
uncertain: Deliberate trailing after-clause retains Bright's unfinished objection.

rows.en: I believe RahXephon... and the EVAs pose similar risks, don't they?
rows.notes: Oki challenges Bright by comparing Zeorymer with the other dangerous machines already aboard.

rows.en: ...You've got some nerve saying that.
rows.notes: Misato inwardly resents Oki's jab at the EVAs.

rows.en: He's not entirely wrong, though...
rows.notes: Haruka inwardly concedes the RahXephon comparison; he refers to Oki.

rows.en: Colonel Bright, just like GEAR, we too are working to defend the Earth Sphere.
rows.notes: Oki formally assures Bright of Last Guardian's defensive mission; GEAR is the organization.

rows.en: I would like you to believe us on that much, at least.
rows.notes: Continues Oki's assurance and request that Bright believe them.

rows.en: ...But the details of Zeorymer are classified. That's what you're saying, isn't it?
rows.notes: Bright identifies the information Oki is withholding, with a pointed confirmation question.

rows.en: I'm glad you understand.
rows.notes: Oki politely acknowledges Bright's understanding.

rows.en: ...Understood.
Well, then...
rows.notes: Conventional departure fragment after Bright's acceptance at i043a:16; trailing ending retained.

rows.en: Are you sure about this, Bright?
rows.notes: Amuro questions Bright's acceptance after Oki leaves.

rows.en: One or two more secrets won't change our situation at this point.
rows.notes: Bright responds that further classified matters do not change their predicament.

rows.en: I know how you feel, but you mustn't lose your temper.
rows.notes: Quattro cautions Bright against acting out of anger.

rows.en: Of course. In fact, I think we've gained a bargaining chip with parties outside the military brass.
rows.notes: Bright is making a calculated bargain with actors outside military command, not trading military secrets away.

rows.en: You mean you'll ask for something in return for letting them use us?
rows.notes: Quattro restates the bargain: compensation for their being used.

rows.en: Yes. A lead that will get us closer to the truth.
rows.notes: Bright specifies what he seeks: a lead toward the truth.

rows.en: I'm Miku Himuro, a pilot of Zeorymer.
rows.notes: Miku introduces herself and her piloting role with her full glossary name.

rows.en: I'm Akitsu... Masato Akitsu.
rows.notes: Masato hesitates after his surname; English order repeats the surname to preserve that hesitation.
Deliberate silence retained.

rows.en: They don't seem very eager to welcome us. I can't blame them, though...
rows.notes: Miku reads the silence from Tetsuya and Hayato at i043a:26-27.

rows.en: I never expected those two to be Zeorymer's pilots.
rows.notes: Domon expresses surprise at the pilots' identities.

rows.en: They're about my age... I can't believe it...
rows.notes: Shinji compares the newly introduced pilots' ages with his own.

rows.en: Are you saying that kid really did all that...?
rows.notes: Maria refers to Masato and Zeorymer's previous attack, not a new act by Miku.

rows.en: He seems like a completely different person from last time.
rows.notes: Chibodee compares timid Masato with the earlier hostile pilot persona.

rows.en: He was laughing so much back then, though...
rows.notes: Beecha recalls Masato's laughter in the hostile persona; subject restored.

rows.en: Could it really be a different pilot after all?
rows.notes: Female lead wonders if it was a different pilot; placeholder speaker preserved.

rows.en: No, he might have a split personality.
rows.notes: Hayato counters the different-pilot theory with a split-personality possibility; Masato is the referent.

rows.en: ...Let me ask you one thing. Why do you two fight in Zeorymer?
rows.notes: Daisuke addresses both pilots, asking their motive for fighting in Zeorymer.

rows.en: To stop the Hau Dragon's ambitions.
rows.notes: Miku answers Daisuke: to stop Hau Dragon's ambitions. The source gives the written name then its pronunciation for the same organization; English uses the glossary name once.

rows.en: ...Masato... That was your name, right? What about you?
rows.notes: Daisuke turns from Miku's answer to Masato and confirms his name before asking his motive.

rows.en: ...Because... it's my destiny. Because... I have no other choice...
rows.notes: Masato haltingly explains destiny and lack of alternatives; both because clauses and hesitation retained.

rows.en: That kid... is just like me...
rows.notes: Shinji identifies with Masato's compelled piloting.

rows.en: I understand. We welcome you both as our comrades. We'll be counting on you from now on.
rows.notes: Daisuke accepts both pilots and asks for their future cooperation; request direction preserved.

rows.en: Yes, and we'll be counting on you too. ...Let's go, Masato.
rows.notes: Miku reciprocates the cooperation request and then asks Masato to leave with her.

rows.en: Y-yeah...
rows.notes: Masato's stammered assent retained.

rows.en: ...Is that really all right, big brother?
rows.notes: Maria questions her brother Daisuke's acceptance after the pilots leave.

rows.en: It's not a question of right or wrong. They're our comrades, and they'll be fighting alongside us.
rows.notes: Daisuke says their future shared fighting establishes comradeship.

rows.en: I'm not going to accept some pretty words like that, Daisuke.
rows.notes: Tetsuya rejects Daisuke's fine-sounding justification sharply.

rows.en: But they must have their own reasons...
rows.notes: Daisuke maintains that the pilots have circumstances of their own.

rows.en: Even if they can't tell us what those reasons are, I don't think we should look at them any differently.
rows.notes: Daisuke argues that undisclosable circumstances should not change how they regard the pilots.

rows.en: Hah! Would you still be able to say that if he shot you in the back?
rows.notes: Chibodee challenges Daisuke with hypothetical betrayal by Masato; no softened threat.

rows.en: As I said before, if that happens, I'll steel myself to do what I must.
rows.notes: Direct callback to s0430:295-296: Daisuke will steel himself if Zeorymer becomes an enemy.

rows.en: That might be too late, you know. Once that Zeorymer has unleashed its full power.
rows.notes: Hayato warns that resolution may come too late after Zeorymer fully releases its power; deliberate after-clause retained.

rows.en: That may be true...
rows.notes: Female lead inwardly agrees with Hayato's danger assessment.

rows.en: Its power system seems to work on a similar principle to the TE Engine, but...
rows.notes: Female lead compares Zeorymer's power system to the TE Engine; but trails into next thought.

rows.en: The source it draws from and the energy itself are completely different...
rows.notes: Continues 215, contrasting the origin drawn from and the energy itself; no dimension lore added.

rows.en: ...I've heard that Zeorymer was developed by Hau Dragon...
rows.notes: Tetsuya warns Daisuke and the gathered pilots; restores first-person hearsay.

rows.en: And there's a lot we don't know about that organization, Last Guardian.
rows.notes: Tetsuya continues the suspicion of Last Guardian; organization remains named.

rows.en: If they have secret ties to Hau Dragon... a fatal blow won't begin to cover it.
rows.notes: They refers to Last Guardian; catastrophic consequence exceeds the prior fatal-blow warning.
uncertain: They is read as Last Guardian from immediately preceding row218; the organizational suspicion also implicates Masato and his companions.

rows.en: If you're right, they must have had chances to defeat us before now...
rows.notes: Daisuke answers Tetsuya; they refers to Masato and his allies/Last Guardian, us to the team.

rows.en: Even if we suspect Masato and the others, I think we need more information.
rows.notes: Daisuke urges evidence before judging Masato and companions.

rows.en: ...I agree.
rows.notes: Domon agrees with Daisuke; restores I; ignores stray closing wrapper and indent.

rows.en: Oh? You're saying you trust that guy?
rows.notes: Chibodee challenges Domon; that guy is Masato.

rows.en: If you get caught up in the facts right in front of you, you can't see the truth behind them.
rows.notes: Domon answers Chibodee with a general principle; you is generic.

rows.en: ...That's what I learned from Schwarz Bruder.
rows.notes: Domon names the mentor who taught that principle; full source name retained.
Chibodee is struck silent by the Schwarz reference; deliberate nonverbal fragment.

rows.en: But that boy's eyes...
rows.notes: Domon private thought about Masato; deliberate eyes fragment continues into 228.

rows.en: Something about them reminds me of Schwarz... who was a shadow of my brother Kyoji...
rows.notes: It is Masato's eyes that remind Domon of Schwarz; brother Kyoji belongs to Domon. Metaphorical shadow retained.
uncertain: The resemblance is read as Masato's eyes continuing row227; shadow remains metaphorical, with no new identity explanation added.

rows.en: The Dimensional Coupler System...?
rows.notes: Amuro repeats the technical term as a question; deliberate echo fragment.

rows.en: Yes. It's a system installed in Zeorymer.
rows.notes: Misato answers Amuro; restores it/system; ignores stray wrapper and indent.

rows.en: What kind of system is it?
rows.notes: Quattro asks about the system, not the robot.

rows.en: We don't know exactly how it works, but it absorbs limitless energy from another dimension... and uses that energy.
rows.notes: Misato explains the system; ignorance concerns detailed operating principles; energy absorption and use both retained.

rows.en: I have that information too, but you seem to know more, don't you?
rows.notes: Haruka addresses Misato, asking whether she has further information.

rows.en: Yes, a little. About Dr. Masaki Kihara, who created that Zeorymer...
rows.notes: Misato answers Haruka; source trails after identifying knowledge about the creator; keeps about fragment.

rows.en: Have you met him?
rows.notes: Vega asks Misato whether she met Masaki Kihara; he is glossary-sourced male.

rows.en: No. I never met him, but I remember my father mentioning his name.
rows.notes: Misato denies meeting Kihara and remembers her father saying the name.

rows.en: Dr. Katsuragi... He proposed Super Solenoid theory, commonly known as S2 theory.
rows.notes: Haruka identifies Misato's father and the theory he proposed. Explicit he/proposed restores the source-settled subject and action. Root confirmed naming; fan-translated official terminology supports spelling, not licensed-English status.
uncertain: Term provenance: no exact Akurasu theory entry; Eva Otaku's fan translation of official Death & Rebirth terminology corroborates Super Solenoid / S2 theory, without proving licensed English.

rows.en: If I recall, fifteen years ago... he led an expedition to Antarctica, and...
rows.notes: Haruka recalls Katsuragi leading the Antarctic expedition and hesitates before the death; deliberate unfinished ending.

rows.en: Yes. My father was caught in the Second Impact and died.
rows.notes: Misato completes the death disclosure; Second Impact is the cause.

rows.en: From what you've said... can we infer that Dr. Katsuragi and Dr. Kihara were both involved in NERV's predecessor organization?
rows.notes: Quattro infers that both scientists had ties to NERV's predecessor; retains inference/question.

rows.en: ...Most likely, yes.
rows.notes: Misato tentatively affirms Quattro's inference; restores yes rather than unresolved subject omission.

rows.en: But Dr. Kihara died under mysterious circumstances fifteen years ago... It'll be hard to uncover the truth.
rows.notes: Vega says Kihara's death limits investigation; both mystery and fifteen-year timing retained.

rows.en: Yes. We won't find a lead that easily... But I think it's worth investigating.
rows.notes: Misato answers Vega; lead translates tail idiom, investigation still worthwhile.

rows.en: Yes... I'll help too.
rows.notes: Haruka agrees and offers assistance; explicit I retained.

rows.en: Depending on what we find, it could mean that NERV and Hau Dragon have some sort of connection.
rows.notes: Quattro states the conditional organizational connection, not established fact.

rows.en: Yes. This seems to go... much deeper than I thought.
rows.notes: Amuro agrees; this story/investigation has deeper implications than expected.

rows.en: Heh... So the moon failed to shine in the heavens. How pathetic, Ritsu.
rows.notes: Scene shifts to Hau Dragon; Saiga taunts Ritsu after defeat; moon/heavens allusion retained.
Ritsu stays silent; deliberate nonverbal omission.

rows.en: Is that all your obsession amounted to?
rows.notes: Saiga challenges Ritsu's obsession.

rows.en: I'd accept a reprimand from the Empress, but you have no right to say that to me...!
rows.notes: Ritsu distinguishes the Empress's legitimate rebuke from Saiga's; source-backed Empress title.

rows.en: Oh...? Is that something a man who came slinking back after fleeing can say?
rows.notes: Saiga mocks Ritsu's shameful flight and return; rhetorical question preserved.

rows.en: Stop this pointless bickering.
rows.notes: Yuratei orders both to stop bickering.

rows.en: Yes, Your Majesty...
rows.notes: Saiga acknowledges Yuratei's order; formal acknowledgement is not a laugh.

rows.en: The other organizations have begun to show more activity of late.
rows.notes: Yuratei addresses her officers; other factions are growing active.

rows.en: We must also prepare for the Hades Project, the cherished ambition of our Tekkoryu... We shall watch and wait for a while.
rows.notes: Yuratei cites Tekkoryu's Hades Project preparations as another reason to watch and wait; aspiration retained. Source-written Tekkoryu follows root-approved body form without explanatory parenthesis; phonetic Hau Dragon remains distinct elsewhere.

rows.en: Understood.
rows.notes: Luhran acknowledges Yuratei's strategy.

rows.en: Rockfell, go out and gather information.
rows.notes: Yuratei orders Rockfell to leave and collect intelligence; request direction is ruler to subordinate.

rows.en: Yes, Your Majesty.
rows.notes: Rockfell formally acknowledges the order.

rows.en: Zeorymer of the Heavens... Masato Akitsu, and Miku Himuro...
rows.notes: Yuratei's private list of hated targets; deliberate noun/name fragment, full source names retained.

rows.en: I will not tolerate their existence. When the time is ripe, I shall mobilize all of Tekkoryu's might and obliterate them without fail...!
rows.notes: Yuratei privately vows to eliminate the listed targets when ready, with her organization's entire strength; threat not softened. Source-written Tekkoryu follows root-approved body form without explanatory parenthesis; phonetic Hau Dragon remains distinct elsewhere.

Generic143 rows match reviewed template JP/kind/effective speaker. Thirty special reused rows examined with scene neighbors; later silences and all four uses of52 rechecked against final translations. Moonlight and Dr. Katsuragi/S2 terminology centrally sourced without attack/mechanism substitutions. No measured compression.
